subject: Is there an alternative to IA calculation that can be used for individuals with low genetic distance

messages.author: d89993b905b0ab8c
messages.subject: Is there an alternative to IA calculation that can be used for individuals with low genetic distance
parts:
Hi, 

I am using DArT data for analysis of recombination and I was looking for the statistical test, which can calculate association between alleles at different loci for the individuals with very low genetic distance (less than 5%) in poppr. I am looking for an alternative to an index of association calculation. Because the genetic distance between the individuals in my population is very low, IA doesn't seem to be an appropriate statistical test for my population. Any suggestions will be highly appreciated.  

Many Thanks, 
Barsha

messages.author: d4586792679cf1d0
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Is there an alternative to IA calculation that can be used for individuals with low genetic distance
parts:
Hi Barsha,

No, there is no alternative. By definition if you have low diversity you are likely looking at clones or selfing organisms and markers will be linked with any metric.

Best wishes,
Nik
